moments.title: Insurance as a first lesson: what kinds exist, and that some of it returns money
moments.summary: A participant names insurance as the thing she learned first — the kinds of insurance available, that an insurance product can carry an investment or some form of return, and life and term insurance and how they split.
moments.evidence: it was about the insurance and what kind of insurance is there and also that you can have an investment with your you can have some form of return with the insurance and your life term insurance

moments.title: Her husband went from "go figure it out yourself" to showing her his analysis
moments.summary: A participant describes the change at home: when she first asked for the insurance funds he told her to do it herself, and now he answers her detailed questions with more respect and offers to show her his analysis so she can evaluate it.
moments.evidence: now when I'm asking him questions he has a lot more respect and he is willing to answer my detailed questions whereas earlier he kind of was like oh you just read that somewhere
